meta.allocation_rule: sqrt(N_h) allocation with a 25-pair floor, largest-remainder rounding to 300; not claimed to be Neyman-optimal
meta.note: HIDDEN KEY. Do not open before annotating.

practice.type: synthetic training examples; excluded from study

stratum_definition.S1_same_answer_lexical_diff: answer_class(A) == answer_class(B) AND norm_key(A) != norm_key(B) (both KEYS present; correctness vs gold not required)
stratum_definition.S4_missing_key: norm_key(A) is None or norm_key(B) is None (one or both replies have no usable KEY); checked first so the strata stay disjoint

meta.target_population: All stored unordered within-task record pairs in the original frame, including cross-model pairs; pair-weighted, not task-equal or model-specific.
meta.instrument_policy: lexical includes (answer,None); key_exact undefined on missing KEY; scorer recomputes all predicates
